finding: Step 6 of the run by hand tells the agent what to do only when merge-story records the story as blocked. It says nothing about the other refusal by hand: merge-story exits 1, merges nothing, and keeps the entry dispatched when premerge-check refuses or git refuses the checkout or the merge (BR-124). In that case the primary checkout holds the User's uncommitted change, and BR-124 says the User commits or reverts it before the next merge-story. The agent text gives no instruction, so an agent may rerun merge-story at once or try to clean the checkout itself. The smallest fix is one sentence in step 6: when merge-story exits 1 and the story stays dispatched, show its message unchanged, change no file in the primary checkout, and wait for the User before the next merge-story.
